newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPG prices are steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPG prices are steady to firmer.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were steady to higher in moderate trade Thursday, industry sources said.
Sentiment was still bullish, inspired by recent crude oil gains and tight stocks, but buyers were less aggressive today than in recent sessions, they said.
Mont Belvieu propane was pegged at 47.00 cents, with most other natural gas liquids stable to 0.25 cent higher than Wednesday's assessments.
EIA data released Wednesday showed Gulf Coast propane stocks 5.4 million barrels below this time last year. Gulf stocks grew by 400,000 barrels for the month ending August 31.
Midwest propane stocks gained 2.3 million barrels and U.S. inventories grew a scant 2.1 million, the report said.
